The PKGBUILD defines sources using standard, expected patterns: it fetches prebuilt binaries and documentation files from the project's official GitHub repository via HTTPS. The `pkgver()` function is not defined, so no dynamic version calculation occurs. All variables are declarative and involve simple string concatenation or array assignments. The checksums are provided and non-skipped, meaning the downloaded files will be verified after download. No code is executed during the sourcing of this PKGBUILD — only variables are set. The commands `makepkg --nobuild --nodeps --noprepare` will safely download and extract the listed sources without executing any part of the build or install process.

Therefore, sourcing this PKGBUILD and fetching the sources poses no risk of remote code execution, data exfiltration, or unintended side effects.
</details>
